item.title: Stranded travelers face uncertainty as Middle East airspace remains closed
item.description: Hundreds of thousands of travelers were stranded after the US and Israel attacked Iran, causing many airports in the Middle East to close and flights to be canceled.

item.title: Ohio State defeats No. 8 Purdue 82-74 behind Mobley Jr.’s 21 points
item.description: Ohio State beat Purdue 82-74, led by John Mobley Jr. with 21 points, to revive their NCAA Tournament hopes.

item.title: Iran faces power struggle as Khamenei’s successor remains undecided
item.description: The killing of Ayatollah Ali Khamenei has created a power vacuum in Iran, and a three-person council has been formed to hold power until a successor is chosen by the Assembly of Experts.

item.title: Family claims abuse in Henry County jail led to son’s death; sheriff denies
item.description: Nicholas Gulley, who had been arrested for trespassing and jailed in Henry County, Indiana, was airlifted to an Indianapolis hospital after, his mother claims, sheriff's deputies used excessive force in an altercation with him. The sheriff's denies the mother's claims. I-Team 8's Tim Spears reports.

item.title: All INdiana Politics: Political experts weigh in on Trump’s Iran air strikes
item.description: President Trump has called on the Iranian people to rise up and overthrow the Islamic regime, but the air strikes on Iran could pose a risk to his presidency depending on what happens next.

item.title: Fernando Mendoza receives hero’s welcome at St. Elmo Steak House
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza was greeted with a standing ovation at St. Elmo Steak House in Indianapolis, where he is attending the NFL Combine, after leading the Hoosiers to their first ever football national championship and winning the Heisman Trophy.

item.title: Iran vows revenge after the killing of its top leader and trades strikes with Israel in widening war
item.description: Israel launched a daylight attack on Iran's capital, with the US participating, in an attempt to pressure Iran into a deal over its nuclear program.

item.title: Indianapolis turns wintry tonight then swings warm and wet | Mar. 1, 2026
item.description: Indianapolis is expecting a wintry mix tonight with snow as the main concern, followed by a period of rain and thunderstorms through the week with temperatures rising from the 40s to the upper 60s.

item.title: Suspect in Texas shooting wore ‘Property of Allah’ clothing with Iranian flag, AP sources says
item.description: Three people were killed and 14 others were transported to a hospital after a shooting at Buford's Bar in Austin, Texas, with the suspect later killed by police.

item.title: The Latest: Jerusalem under fire as Trump says fighting in Iran could last ‘4 weeks or so’
item.description: The U.S. and Israel launched a major attack on Iran, prompting Iran to retaliate with missile and drone attacks, leading to calls for emergency meetings from the U.N. Security Council and the European Union, while the EU has labeled Iran a threat to global security.
